title: Measuring Moral LLM Responses in Multilingual Capacities
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific to faith or religion. It focused on general moral and ethical responses across five categories: Biases & Stereotypes, Consent & Autonomy, Harm Prevention & Safety, Legality, and Moral Judgment.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
